notes: Made.com UK (Next-operated storefront, confirmed live and reachable via curl_cffi safari17_0/17_2_ios/15_3/firefox133 impersonation profiles; Akamai bot-manager intermittently returns a JS-challenge stub for ~30-40% of requests on the same URL/profile, worked around by retrying). Checked: (1) robots.txt facet allow/disallow list - no feat-bestseller/feat-popular/feat-trending facet is referenced anywhere (only feat-newin, feat-sale, feat-backinstock, feat-deliveryby, feat-available exist as recognised facet values); (2) direct URL probes /best-sellers, /bestsellers, /shop/bestsellers - all resolve to the site's generic catch-all template that auto-titles ANY /shop/<slug> path as 'Buy <Slug> Online' with totalResults:0 (verified this is a universal fallback by requesting a nonsense slug /shop/zzznonexistentxyz, which produced the identical pattern - title 'Buy Zzznonexistentxyz Online', totalResults 0, identical byte length ~318k); (3) facet probes /shop/f/feat-bestseller, /shop/f/feat-bestsellers, /shop/f/feat-popular - all fall back further to the bare unfiltered /shop/f/ template ('Buy Shop Online', totalResults 0), confirming these are not recognised facet keys at all (unlike feat-newin/feat-sale which return populated, correctly-titled pages); (4) 'Most Popular' exists only as a sort-order option (sorting.options value='popular') on every category listing, not a distinct PLP - excluded per brief as an arbitrary sort, not a listing; (5) site's own search for 'bestsellers' and 'best sellers' returns totalResults:1 - a single incidental free-text match, not a merchandising listing; (6) full sitemap-index (Made-GB-EN-Category.xml.gz, 12,150 URLs, and Made-GB-EN-Collections.xml.gz, 47 URLs) greped for bestsel/best-sel/popular/trending/favourite/top-sel/topsel - zero matches in either. No main-nav mega-menu markup was present in the raw homepage HTML (it is populated by a separate client-side header microservice not reachable via this route), so nav-menu inspection relied on the facet/sitemap/catch-all-template evidence above instead, which is conclusive: the platform simply has no Bestsellers concept implemented for this storefront. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers PLP exists on made.com currently.
